customMethods.script:
def sortNavigationItems(items):
		items.sort(key=lambda item: (
			item['sortOrder'] if item['sortOrder'] is not None else 999999,
			item['name']
		))
	
		for item in items:
			sortNavigationItems(item['children'])
		
		return

	rowsByPath = {}
	excludePaths = []
	rootItems = []

	security = self.view.custom.security
	isGatewayAdmin = security['userCRUD']['isGatewayAdmin']
	userRoles = self.view.custom.security.roles
	project = system.util.getProjectName()

	for row in data:
		path = row['path']

		if not isGatewayAdmin:
			roles = system.util.jsonDecode(row['roles']) if row['roles'] else []
			if roles and len(roles) != 0 and not any(role in userRoles for role in roles):
				excludePaths.append(path)
				continue

		projects = system.util.jsonDecode(row['project']) if row['project'] else []
		if projects and len(projects) != 0 and project not in projects:
			excludePaths.append(path)
			continue

		if any(excludePath == path or path.startswith(excludePath + '\\') for excludePath in excludePaths): continue

		rowsByPath[path] = {
			'id': row['id'],
			'project': row['project'],
			'name': row['name'],
			'parentId': row['parentId'],
			'viewPath': row['viewPath'],
			'path': path,
			'icon': row['icon'],
			'type': row['type'],
			'enabled': row['enabled'],
			'sortOrder': row['sortOrder'],
			'roles': row['roles'],
			'children': []
		}

	for path in list(rowsByPath.keys()):
		pathParts = path.split('\\')

		for index in range(1, len(pathParts)):
			parentPath = '\\'.join(pathParts[:index])

			if parentPath not in rowsByPath:
				rowsByPath[parentPath] = {
					'id': None,
					'project': None,
					'name': pathParts[index - 1],
					'parentId': None,
					'viewPath': None,
					'path': parentPath,
					'icon': None,
					'type': None,
					'enabled': True,
					'sortOrder': None,
					'roles': None,
					'children': []
				}

	for path, item in rowsByPath.items():
		parentPath = path.rsplit('\\', 1)[0] if '\\' in path else None

		if parentPath and parentPath in rowsByPath: rowsByPath[parentPath]['children'].append(item)
		else: rootItems.append(item)

	sortNavigationItems(rootItems)

	return rootItems

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("updateNavigation() msg rcvd with " + str(payload))
	# - implement your handler here
	# - any navigation action will call this, ex: menu tree, home button, any links
	# - this function adds new history items
	# - if this function is called when currentIndex is not pointing to the end of history,
	# delete every entry after the currentIndex, then add the new history item
	# - afterwards, navigate to the newly added history item/view

	if payload['type']	!= 'url':	#urls will be opened in a new tab so we don't need to store history
			
		pageId = self.page.props.pageId
		if '/' in pageId: pageId = 'designer'		#For debug in designer
			
		tabNavigation = self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation
		history = tabNavigation["history"]
		currentIndex = tabNavigation["currentIndex"]
		
		if currentIndex < len(history) - 1: self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["history"] = history[:currentIndex + 1]
			
		if history[currentIndex]["path"] != payload["path"]:
			newHistoryItem = {
				"path": payload["path"],
				"name": payload['name'],
				"type": payload['type'],
				"params": system.util.jsonEncode(payload['params'])
			}
			self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["history"].append(newHistoryItem)
			if len(self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["history"]) > 30: self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["history"] = self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["history"][1:]
			else: self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation["currentIndex"] += 1
		else: return
					
	self.navigateTo(payload['type'], payload['path'], payload['params'])

	return

# - passing in parameters, goes back and forth within the history item list
	# - decrements/increments currentIndex for prev/next, then navigates to the item
	# at the new index
	# payload: {direction: (-1 for previous, +1 for next)}
	
	system.perspective.print("traverseNavigation() msg rcvd with %s"%(payload))
	pageId = self.page.props.pageId
	if '/' in pageId: pageId = 'designer'	
	self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation['currentIndex'] += payload['direction']
	newIndex = self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation['currentIndex']
	navHistory = self.session.custom.kanoa[pageId].navigation.history[newIndex]
	navParams = system.util.jsonDecode(navHistory["params"])
	self.navigateTo(navHistory['type'], navHistory['path'], navParams)
	return
